terminal-bench-science.leaderboard_protocol: 3 trials per task, 70 tasks, cost and tokens reported per run
terminal-bench-science.notes: 70 Harbor tasks, no GPUs, 8h agent timeout each. Native images, limits, and verifiers stay in Harbor.

terminal-bench-4-science.leaderboard_protocol: Public leaderboard jobs expose per-task rewards via `harbor hub job tasks <job-id>`; filter to the frozen 14 IDs instead of re-running other harnesses.
terminal-bench-4-science.notes: Science-category slice of Terminal-Bench 4.0 (14 of 66), not Terminal-Bench-Science and not the historical TB3 Science 15.

biomni-bench-50.leaderboard_protocol: Paper (bioRxiv 10.64898/2026.05.12.724604) scores all 100 tasks with Gemini 3.1 Pro judge, 3 reruns; BiomniBench-AI4S compares 7 agents on the public 50 with deepseek-v4-pro and a DeepSeek+Gemini dual judge.
biomni-bench-50.notes: Public 50 Harbor tasks, 1h budget, 2 CPUs. Judge credentials go to the verifier only (--ve), never the agent environment.

drugdiscoverybench.leaderboard_protocol: 3 runs per setting, mean not best-of-n; each closed model appears in its native harness and in mini-SWE-agent.
drugdiscoverybench.notes: 82 Harbor tasks; rubrics are filled from the gated HF dataset by scripts/populate_rubrics.py. Upstream pins Harbor 0.13.1; we run the same task.toml files under 0.22.0 and record that in the identity.

bixbench3.leaderboard_protocol: 13 models in the Inspect ReAct reference solver, 20 tasks, 24h/5000-message cap; mean artifact score 0-1.
bixbench3.notes: Inspect AI + GCP. OpenScience replaces the reference ReAct solver inside the native agent container; grading stays host-side. The sandbox is egress-isolated behind a Squid allowlist, so the model provider API host must be added to the case network_policy.base_allow_domains.

researchclawbench.leaderboard_protocol: RADS 0-100 per task (50 = matches paper); best score per (task, agent), Pass@1 mean over 40 tasks.
researchclawbench.notes: Host workspace + hidden-paper rubric judge. Plug in adapters/researchclaw.py through evaluation/agents.json. Label must stay 'OpenScience (Synthetic Sciences)': their board already has an unrelated 'Open Science'.
